## About the Event

Technovationis the premier annual symposium hosted by the Mechatronics Engineering students of MGIT. It is a dynamic intersection of disciplines where mechanical precision meets electronic intelligence.
The fest brings together students from across colleges for a mix of technical challenges and creative non-technical events. From robotics and design to strategic gaming, Technovation is a platform for talent to shine, ideas to collide, and the next generation of engineers to connect.
